title: One-Basket Skills Circuit
description: A four-station rotation that keeps a whole squad active on a single hoop, mixing shooting, passing, ball handling and footwork at short, timed stations.

content.objective: Give every player many touches at skill work even when only one basket is available, and teach players to move between stations quickly and in silence.
content.setup: Divide the squad into four equal groups. Station A shoots at the basket, Station B works partner passing, Station C works ball handling between cones and Station D works footwork and pivots. Each station is marked with cones.
content.organization: Each station lasts three to four minutes with a short reset to rotate clockwise. The coach works with the shooting station and uses a stopwatch for the rotation.
instructions: Station A: close-range form shooting in pairs, one shooter and one rebounder, swapping after each make.
Station B: partner chest and bounce passes on the move between two cones, counting completed passes.
Station C: dribble through a cone line with the right hand, then the left, then a crossover at each cone.
Station D: triple-threat pivots and jab steps without the ball, then with the ball.
On the whistle everyone rotates clockwise to the next station and starts immediately.
coachingPoints: Work at game speed but with correct technique: quality first.
Make quick, quiet rotations so no time is wasted between stations.
Coach the shooting station in detail and give clear reminders at the others.
Keep score or count reps so every station has a small competition.
commonMistakes: Slow rotations and long conversations between stations.
Shooting from too far away before form is settled.
Ignoring the cones and cutting the dribble line short.
content.safety: Keep the passing lane and dribble lines clear of the shooting area and keep balls off the floor between stations.
progressions: Shorten the rotation to two minutes and increase the required makes at each station.
regressions: Reduce to three stations and allow longer rotations for younger players.
variations: Add a fifth conditioning station with line sprints if the squad is above sixteen players.
